integrity: Standalone checker performs 180 orbit-character comparisons and six mod-two homology vector computations. Infinite-case proof uses equivariant folds and exact sequences; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Integral homology modules and their complete rational characters for natural \(S_n\) by C_2 actions only. Nonequivariant ranks are previously covered by Carnero Bravo (2026), Corollary 8. No genuine equivariant homotopy type, fixed-point-space homotopy, integral quotient homology or iterated Mycielskians. Residual originality risk from uninspected literature.
title: Integral symmetry modules of generalized Mycielskian crown independence complexes
